ambiguities_or_notes: долг 400 р. оставался до следующего писанья is rendered ‘let the debt of 400 rubles remain until my next piece of writing,’ preserving the sense that the existing advance/debt is carried forward rather than paid from the Snowstorm fee.
Ваш Толстой is kept simply as ‘Yours, Tolstoy.’
The editorial notation's за Толстым осталось is rendered ‘Tolstoy still owed,’ and the source's [неразобр.] remains [illegible] rather than being reconstructed.
